# DocSmith for Ansible: role with long names (for testing)

**This is a mock Ansible role intended for testing purposes only.**

The variables of this role start with a 64-character role name, the maximum
Galaxy accepts. Its generated README has to pass the foundata Markdown rules in
`.rumdl.toml`.
